pr_snapshot.body:
The ARM VP8 vertical filter repeatedly packs scalar row loads and computes dynamic indices for its three fixed internal edges. Use 16-byte SIMD row loads and fixed edges 8/12/16 while retaining the exact signed arithmetic, carried corrected neighbors, and packed stores. The existing guard proves the complete 20×16 window, including minimal unaligned slices; wider loads add no padding requirement. ARM horizontal and generated x64 filters stay unchanged.

Separately, replace repeated x64 subpixel row slices with exact SIMD array loads after a bounded-geometry proof and the original two endpoint checks. Preserve the original checked-slice implementation for unusual geometry and retain identical two-pass rounding, accumulations, read-only aliases, and AVX upper-lane fence. Independent review and Rosetta selected/checkptr/AVX-disabled/public scalar-oracle checks pass. Native x64 results below measure the final source on actual x64 hardware. Add 40 identical public rectangle/phase/minimal/padded fixtures to ASM/main/current, preserving all 206 old cases (246 total), eight source hashes, required full subpixel tests, and targeted native race/checkptr checks.

Shared SIMD subpixel identity filters `{128,0}` now reuse the existing SIMD statistics kernel after preserving both original bilinear read-window checks. On M4 Max, six fresh balanced prototype-parent/assembly/current rounds over all 40 new fixtures give **1.695–2.334× the immediate parent `a5401799`** for the eight full-pixel fixtures; every one of the 48 paired samples exceeds **1.653× that parent** with zero allocations. Other 32 phase controls are **0.983–1.004×**. The 16×8 cases beat assembly **1.038–1.068×**; the other measured full-pixel sizes still trail assembly (**0.481–0.708×**). Keep this correctness-verified ≥1.5× component win independently of whole-codec results under AGENTS.md. Separate six-round whole-VP8 results versus `a5401799` are **+0.145% time** over 300 frames (1/6 faster) and **+0.269%** over 60 frames (3/6 faster), with all 23 non-timing fields exact and zero allocations; still **+10.176% / +9.387%** versus assembly. Keep the qualifying kernel win despite these small whole-codec regressions. Six fixed-speed packet/drop digests match the validated parent. These ARM results do not imply a blanket assembly win or an x64 result. Independent numeric/window/fallback review and existing scalar/all-phase tests pass, with 72 alias/stride/shape cases and 40 retained short-window panic cases. Add the identity tests to required native race/checkptr coverage.

Native Apple M4 Max, Go 1.27.2 archsimd, PGO off, six fresh balanced parent/assembly/current permutations plus the narrow-load unrolled control:

- All **60 public Picker-filter pairs** improve versus the parent, with zero allocations. Active textured cases improve **1.023–1.030×**, and flat/ramp/no-op cases **1.093–1.121×**. This is a smaller consistent gain, not a new 1.5× result. Previously verified ≥1.5× kernels remain intact.
- Whole VP8 720p: **−0.570% encode time** over 300 frames, 5/6 pairs faster; **−0.688%** over 60 frames, 4/6 faster. All 23 output/control fields match, with zero allocations. The assembly gap remains **+9.668% / +10.605%**; active textured filters still trail assembly.

Validation: full native suite before and after refreshed PGO; 7,200 fusion/scalar cases plus 640 zero-correction/later-edge cases; race/checkptr2; six identical packet/drop digests; independent bounds/carry/lane-order review; generated instruction words exactly match the timed prototype; noasm/build-selection/precommit gates. Raw samples, source snapshots, qualitative profile, and unselected widening-multiply/horizontal probes are preserved under benchmarks. README files and dependencies unchanged.

Archive PR35's complete native x64 and optimized-libvpx evidence separately: EPYC 7763 VP8 time −7.659% versus main / −20.790% versus old assembly; retained VP9 controls +1.907% / +0.688% versus main while still beating assembly. Separate EPYC 9V45 fixed-quality VP8 encode time is 2.415902× optimized libvpx (+141.5902%; libvpx is faster) with matched measured quality/output counts. All regressions, the assembly allocation outlier, raw samples, and workload limits remain included.
Final exact-head CI and native results for `eb820478` (Go 1.27.2, PGO off):

- All three checks pass. On **Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C**, all **246 kernels × six samples × three variants** have zero bytes/allocations; eight recorded source hashes match. **103 targeted checks / 248 PASS lines** include identity and pointer tests under selected SIMD and race/checkptr, with no failures or skips. All 22 semantic fields and every public/profile allocation sample match; no allocation outlier in this job.
- All **40 public subpixel fixtures** improve against main in every pair. Fractional cases gain **1.403–1.559× main / 1.579–3.609× ASM**. Six identity cases at 16×8, 16×16 and 16×32 gain **1.965–2.953× main** (minimum pair **1.952×**) and **1.076–1.273× ASM**. The two 32×16 identity cases gain **1.288–1.308× main**, but remain **75.86–76.89% slower than ASM**. Twenty of 40 cases exceed 1.5× main in every pair; this is not a blanket threshold claim.
- Whole VP8 time is **+1.1695% versus main** (3/6 pairs faster), while **−27.5749% versus ASM**. VP9 320 time is **−0.1771% versus main** (5/6) / **−42.2673% versus ASM**; VP9 720 is **−2.9279% versus main** (6/6) / **−49.3338% versus ASM**. Keep all **173 median kernel regressions and 15 all-six-slower cases** in the audit/raw evidence. Unchanged kernels remain controls; shared subpixel paths include the new guard. These CPU-scoped results do not establish prior EPYC 9V74 gap closure or isolate the cause of whole-codec changes.
- Optimized libvpx runs separately on **EPYC 7763**. Fixed-speed VP8 Go takes **2.305785× libvpx time** (+130.5785%; libvpx is faster), with matched measured PSNR/SSIM/payload/frame counts. This does not prove bitstream identity. Adaptive VP8 and VP9 compare unequal quality/output work; every quality-pass output statistic matches the timed output, and all reference timers use `vpxenc-stats`. Pinned upstream ASM/SSE2/AVX2/runtime dispatch are enabled. Never combine absolute timings from the native and C hosts.

Complete byte-preserved raw evidence and audits include every regression and both separately scoped predecessor measurements. The final native/C archive contains 86 + 74 raw files with per-member and outer SHA256 verification. No README expansion or dependencies added.
